Stats

Vampire_Spawn
Pale Petras is a Vampire Spawn enslaved to  Cazador, and one of  Astarion's siblings. He may appear at Fraygo's Flophouse or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three.

Involvement

Petras can first be encountered on the first floor of Fraygo's Flophouse in Wyrm's Crossing, where he is hunting with  Dalyria.[1] If  Astarion is present, the three have a confrontation about  Cazador and his intentions for the ritual.

If Astarion is not present, the party can eavesdrop on their conversation:

  • [STEALTH] Listen in. (DC 15)
  • [ROGUE] [STEALTH] Listen in. (DC 15 )

Whether or not the check succeeds or fails, the party can interject by stating they know Astarion or they are interested in the 'party'. The spawn invite the party and then leave.

Petras later can be encountered with the other spawn in Cazador's Dungeon, trapped and suspended while Cazador prepares for his ritual. Like the other spawn, he can be spared or killed after the ritual, or allowed to be consumed as one of its sacrifices.

Idle banter

  • Pale Petras
    Not long before we leave scouring places like this behind. Part of me will miss it.
  • Dalyria
    I will not. It is our chance to start over, and I will gladly do so.
  • Pale Petras
    Do you think the master plans to expand his territory? Take Candlekeep - maybe even Amn?
  • Dalyria
    Oh, I'm sure he has plans. But I wouldn't dare guess at them.
  • Dalyria
    Haven't we lingered long enough? We should return for the ceremony.
  • Pale Petras
    We have time - the runaway is still missing, after all. Nothing happens until he's found.
  • Pale Petras
    Just think - soon we'll feel the sun on our skin. After all this time...
